chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:

I said to him: A man does not know whether he has prayed one or two. He said: “He repeats.” I said: A man did not know whether he prayed two or three. He said: “If doubt enters him after his entering into the third, he proceeds in the third, then prays the other one, and there is nothing upon him, and he gives salām.”

key_terms.الْأُخْرَى: the remaining rakʿah needed to complete the prayer
key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no penalty or liability upon him
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: he concludes the prayer with salām

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he doubts the number of rakʿahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on doubt in salat (prayer) regarding the number of rakʿahs. If a person doubts between one and two, he repeats the prayer; if he doubts between two and three after entering the third, he continues and completes the prayer without liability.
